836:     console.log(`  Filtered out ${filtered} NPCs (tutorial, antimacro, unnamed)`);
837:     console.log(`  Remaining: ${filteredConfigs.size} configs`);
838: 
839:     // ─── Step 3: Deduplicate by display name ─────────────────────────────
840: 
841:     console.log('\nStep 3: Deduplicating by display name...');
842: 
843:     const pagesByName = new Map<string, NpcPage>();
844:     for (const [configName, config] of filteredConfigs) {
845:         const displayName = config.name;
846: 
847:         if (!pagesByName.has(displayName)) {
848:             pagesByName.set(displayName, {
849:                 displayName,
850:                 variants: [],
851:                 spawns: [],
852:                 drops: [],
853:                 alwaysDropItem: null,
854:                 alwaysDropExtra: [],
855:                 clueTier: null,
856:             });
857:         }
858: 
859:         const page = pagesByName.get(displayName)!;
860:         page.variants.push(config);
861:     }
862:     console.log(`  Deduplicated to ${pagesByName.size} unique NPC pages`);
863: 
864:     // ─── Step 4: Resolve drops and spawns ────────────────────────────────
865: 
866:     console.log('\nStep 4: Resolving drops and spawns...');
867: 
868:     for (const [displayName, page] of pagesByName) {
869:         // Collect spawns from all variants
870:         const seenMapSquares = new Set<string>();
871:         for (const variant of page.variants) {
872:             const variantSpawns = spawns.get(variant.configName) || [];
873:             for (const spawn of variantSpawns) {
874:                 if (!seenMapSquares.has(`${spawn.mapSquare}_${spawn.level}`)) {
875:                     seenMapSquares.add(`${spawn.mapSquare}_${spawn.level}`);
876:                     page.spawns.push(spawn);
877:                 }
878:             }
879:         }
880: 
881:         // Resolve death_drop (always drop item)
882:         // Count all variants - those without explicit death_drop default to "bones" for combat NPCs
883:         const deathDropCounts = new Map<string, number>();
884:         for (const variant of page.variants) {
885:             const dd = variant.params.get('death_drop');
886:             if (dd === 'null') {
887:                 // Explicitly drops nothing
888:             } else if (dd) {
889:                 deathDropCounts.set(dd, (deathDropCounts.get(dd) || 0) + 1);
890:             } else if (isCombatNpc(variant)) {
891:                 // No explicit death_drop → default is "bones"
892:                 deathDropCounts.set('bones', (deathDropCounts.get('bones') || 0) + 1);
893:             }
894:         }
895:         if (deathDropCounts.size > 0) {
896:             // Pick the most common death_drop
897:             let bestDrop = '';
898:             let bestCount = 0;
899:             for (const [drop, count] of deathDropCounts) {
900:                 if (count > bestCount) { bestDrop = drop; bestCount = count; }
901:             }
902:             page.alwaysDropItem = bestDrop;
903:         }
904: 
905:         // Find drop table
906:         for (const variant of page.variants) {
907:             // Check direct config name trigger
908:             for (const [, table] of dropTables) {
909:                 if (table.triggerNames.includes(variant.configName)) {
910:                     if (page.drops.length === 0) {
911:                         page.drops = [...table.entries];
912:                         page.alwaysDropExtra = [...table.alwaysDropItems];
913:                         if (table.clueTier) page.clueTier = table.clueTier;
914:                     }
915:                     break;
916:                 }
917:             }
918:             if (page.drops.length > 0) break;
919: 
920:             // Check _category trigger
921:             if (variant.category) {
922:                 for (const [, table] of dropTables) {
923:                     if (table.triggerNames.includes(`_${variant.category}`)) {
924:                         if (page.drops.length === 0) {
925:                             page.drops = [...table.entries];
926:                             page.alwaysDropExtra = [...table.alwaysDropItems];
927:                             if (table.clueTier) page.clueTier = table.clueTier;
928:                         }
929:                         break;
930:                     }
931:                 }
932:                 if (page.drops.length > 0) break;
933:             }
934:         }
935:     }
936: 
937:     // ─── Step 5: Generate markdown ───────────────────────────────────────
938: 
939:     console.log('\nStep 5: Generating markdown...');
940: 
941:     mkdirSync(NPC_DIR, { recursive: true });
942: 
943:     let generated = 0;
944:     const pageIndex: { name: string; file: string }[] = [];
945: 
946:     for (const [displayName, page] of pagesByName) {
947:         const slug = displayName.toLowerCase()
948:             .replace(/['']/g, '')
949:             .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
950:             .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
951: 
952:         const fileName = `${slug}.md`;
953:         const filePath = join(NPC_DIR, fileName);
954: 
955:         const md = generateNpcMarkdown(page, objNames);
956:         writeFileSync(filePath, md);
957: 
958:         pageIndex.push({ name: displayName, file: fileName });
959:         generated++;
960:     }
961: 
962:     console.log(`  Generated ${generated} NPC pages`);
963: 
964:     // ─── Step 6: Update README ───────────────────────────────────────────
965: 
966:     console.log('\nStep 6: Updating README...');
967:     updateReadme(pageIndex);
968: 
969:     console.log('\nDone!');
970: }

972: // ─── Generate Markdown for One NPC Page ──────────────────────────────────────
973: 
974: function generateNpcMarkdown(page: NpcPage, objNames: Map<string, string>): string {
975:     const primary = page.variants[0];
976:     const combat = isCombatNpc(primary);
977:     const lines: string[] = [];
978: 
979:     // Title
980:     lines.push(`# ${page.displayName}`);
981:     lines.push('');
982: 
983:     // Info table
984:     lines.push('| Detail | |');
985:     lines.push('|---|---|');
986: 
987:     // Combat level - show range if variants differ
988:     const vislevels = [...new Set(page.variants.map(v => v.vislevel).filter(v => v && v !== 'hide'))];
989:     if (vislevels.length > 1) {
990:         const nums = vislevels.map(v => parseInt(v)).filter(n => !isNaN(n)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
991:         if (nums.length > 1) {
992:             lines.push(`| **Combat Level** | ${nums[0]}-${nums[nums.length - 1]} |`);
993:         } else {
994:             lines.push(`| **Combat Level** | ${vislevels[0]} |`);
995:         }
996:     } else if (vislevels.length === 1) {
997:         lines.push(`| **Combat Level** | ${vislevels[0]} |`);
998:     } else {
999:         lines.push('| **Combat Level** | None |');
1000:     }
1001: 
1002:     // Hitpoints
1003:     const hps = [...new Set(page.variants.map(v => v.hitpoints).filter(h => h > 0))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
1004:     if (hps.length > 1) {
1005:         lines.push(`| **Hitpoints** | ${hps[0]}-${hps[hps.length - 1]} |`);
1006:     } else if (hps.length === 1) {
1007:         lines.push(`| **Hitpoints** | ${hps[0]} |`);
1008:     } else {
1009:         lines.push('| **Hitpoints** | N/A |');
1010:     }
1011: 
1012:     // Description
1013:     lines.push(`| **Description** | ${primary.desc || 'N/A'} |`);
1014: 
1015:     // Aggressive
1016:     const isAggressive = page.variants.some(v => v.huntmode.includes('aggressive'));
1017:     lines.push(`| **Aggressive** | ${isAggressive ? 'Yes' : 'No'} |`);
1018: 
1019:     // Movement
1020:     lines.push(`| **Movement** | ${getMovementDesc(primary)} |`);
1021: 
1022:     // Respawn (only for combat NPCs)
1023:     if (combat) {
1024:         const respawnRates = [...new Set(page.variants.map(v => v.respawnrate).filter(r => r > 0))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
1025:         if (respawnRates.length > 0) {
1026:             if (respawnRates.length > 1) {
1027:                 lines.push(`| **Respawn** | ${respawnRates[0]}-${respawnRates[respawnRates.length - 1]} ticks |`);
1028:             } else {
1029:                 lines.push(`| **Respawn** | ${respawnRates[0]} ticks |`);
1030:             }
1031:         }
1032:     }
1033: 
1034:     lines.push('');
1035: 
1036:     // Combat Stats section (only if NPC has param stats)
1037:     if (hasCombatStats(primary)) {
1038:         lines.push('## Combat Stats');
1039:         lines.push('');
1040:         lines.push('| Stat | Value |');
1041:         lines.push('|------|-------|');
1042: 
1043:         const atkBonus = primary.params.get('attackbonus') || '0';
1044:         const strBonus = primary.params.get('strengthbonus') || '0';
1045:         const stabDef = primary.params.get('stabdefence') || '0';
1046:         const slashDef = primary.params.get('slashdefence') || '0';
1047:         const crushDef = primary.params.get('crushdefence') || '0';
1048:         const magicDef = primary.params.get('magicdefence') || '0';
1049:         const rangeDef = primary.params.get('rangedefence') || '0';
1050:         const style = getAttackStyle(primary.params);
1051: 
1052:         lines.push(`| Attack Bonus | ${atkBonus} |`);
1053:         lines.push(`| Strength Bonus | ${strBonus} |`);
1054:         lines.push(`| Stab Defence | ${stabDef} |`);
1055:         lines.push(`| Slash Defence | ${slashDef} |`);
1056:         lines.push(`| Crush Defence | ${crushDef} |`);
1057:         lines.push(`| Magic Defence | ${magicDef} |`);
1058:         lines.push(`| Range Defence | ${rangeDef} |`);
1059:         lines.push(`| Attack Style | ${style} |`);
1060:         lines.push('');
1061:     }
1062: 
1063:     // Locations section
1064:     if (page.spawns.length > 0) {
1065:         lines.push(page.spawns.length > 1 ? '## Locations' : '## Location');
1066:         lines.push('');
1067:         lines.push('| Map | Coordinate samples |');
1068:         lines.push('|-----|--------------------|');
1069: 
1070:         // Group spawns by map square, retaining exact coordinates. No area names:
1071:         // the hand-written square->area table mislabelled whole regions (e.g. Crandor
1072:         // as Rimmington), and a wrong name misleads more than a missing one. Limit
1073:         // samples so very common NPCs do not produce enormous generated pages.
1074:         const bySquare = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
1075:         for (const spawn of page.spawns) {
1076:             if (!bySquare.has(spawn.mapSquare)) {
1077:                 bySquare.set(spawn.mapSquare, new Set());
1078:             }
1079:             const floor = spawn.level > 0 ? ` L${spawn.level}` : '';
1080:             bySquare.get(spawn.mapSquare)!.add(`(${spawn.globalX}, ${spawn.globalZ})${floor}`);
1081:         }
1082: 
1083:         for (const [square, coordinates] of [...bySquare.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))) {
1084:             const allCoordinates = [...coordinates].sort();
1085:             const coordinateList = allCoordinates.slice(0, 12).join(', ');
1086:             const overflow = allCoordinates.length > 12 ? `, +${allCoordinates.length - 12} more` : '';
1087:             lines.push(`| ${square} | ${coordinateList}${overflow} |`);
1088:         }
1089:         lines.push('');
1090:     } else if (primary.hasPatrol || primary.defaultmode === 'patrol') {
1091:         lines.push('## Location');
1092:         lines.push('');
1093:         lines.push('Patrols; no fixed spawn coordinates recorded.');
1094:         lines.push('');
1095:     }
1096: 
1097:     // Interactions section (for non-combat NPCs with ops)
1098:     if (!combat) {
1099:         const ops = primary.ops.filter(op => op && op !== 'Attack');
1100:         if (ops.length > 0) {
1101:             lines.push('## Interactions');
1102:             lines.push('');
1103:             lines.push('| Option | Action |');
1104:             lines.push('|--------|--------|');
1105:             for (const op of ops) {
1106:                 lines.push(`| ${op} | ${op} |`);
1107:             }
1108:             lines.push('');
1109:         }
1110:     }
1111: 
1112:     // Drops section
1113:     lines.push('## Drops');
1114:     lines.push('');
1115: 
1116:     const alwaysDropName = page.alwaysDropItem ? getObjDisplayName(page.alwaysDropItem, objNames) : null;
1117: 
1118:     if (combat && alwaysDropName && page.alwaysDropItem !== 'null') {
1119:         lines.push(`Always drops: ${alwaysDropName}`);
1120:         lines.push('');
1121:     }
1122: 
1123:     // Always-drop extra items (like raw chicken, cow hide)
1124:     if (page.alwaysDropExtra.length > 0) {
1125:         for (const item of page.alwaysDropExtra) {
1126:             const name = getObjDisplayName(item.itemConfigName, objNames);
1127:             if (item.quantity > 1) {
1128:                 lines.push(`Always drops: ${name} (x${item.quantity})`);
1129:             } else {
1130:                 lines.push(`Always drops: ${name}`);
1131:             }
1132:         }
1133:         lines.push('');
1134:     }
1135: 
1136:     if (page.drops.length > 0) {
1137:         lines.push('| Item | Rarity |');
1138:         lines.push('|------|--------|');
1139: 
1140:         for (const drop of page.drops) {
1141:             const itemName = getObjDisplayName(drop.itemConfigName, objNames);
1142:             let qtyStr = '';
1143:             if (drop.quantity !== '1') {
1144:                 qtyStr = ` (x${drop.quantity})`;
1145:             }
1146:             const membersStr = drop.membersOnly ? ' (members)' : '';
1147:             lines.push(`| ${itemName}${qtyStr} | ${drop.numerator}/${drop.denominator}${membersStr} |`);
1148:         }
1149:         lines.push('');
1150:     } else if (!combat || (!alwaysDropName && page.alwaysDropExtra.length === 0)) {
1151:         lines.push(`${page.displayName} has no drops.`);
1152:         lines.push('');
1153:     }
1154: 
1155:     // Notes section
1156:     const notes = generateNotes(page);
1157:     if (notes.length > 0) {
1158:         lines.push('## Notes');
1159:         lines.push('');
1160:         for (const note of notes) {
1161:             lines.push(`- ${note}`);
1162:         }
1163:         lines.push('');
1164:     }
1165: 
1166:     return lines.join('\n');
1167: }

1169: // ─── Generate Notes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1170: 
1171: function generateNotes(page: NpcPage): string[] {
1172:     const notes: string[] = [];
1173:     const primary = page.variants[0];
1174: 
1175:     // Quest association from source path
1176:     const questMatch = primary.sourcePath.match(/quests\/quest_(\w+)\//);
1177:     if (questMatch) {
1178:         const questName = prettifyConfigName(questMatch[1]);
1179:         notes.push(`Associated with the **${questName}** quest.`);
1180:     }

**Outcome:** I took Bravo from a fresh level-3 to **combat 46** (Attack 47, Strength 41, HP 41, Defence 29) and spent the session fighting alongside Alpha and Charlie on a shared focus-fire plan.

**Key analysis I contributed (in `bots/_team/notes.md` + chat):**

1. **Greater demon L92** @ (3282,3880) — wilderness; too high defence, hits 8s. Died. Aborted.
2. **Ice giant L53** @ (2804,3507) — fenced/unreachable.
